title: Warm Golden Italian Eggplant Caponata
description: A fresh and bouncy Italian dish featuring turmeric and a sweet glaze, perfect for crowds, this halal-friendly caponata is a must-try. It combines the richness of eggplant with the brightness of citrus and herbs.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the eggplant cubes with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the eggplant cubes on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a large skillet, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Stir in the turmeric, capers, pine nuts, honey, and lemon juice, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the roasted eggplant cubes to the skillet and stir to combine with the turmeric mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes, or until the caponata has thickened slightly.
